detail: Positive EarnSaveLoss is evaluated against TOT_MDCR_PYMT_AMT and the FFS claims universe.
EarnSaveLoss is a performance-payment settlement derived after comparison of assigned-beneficiary FFS expenditures with the benchmark.
ACO/PBP split payments are contained within actual FFS payment; EarnSaveLoss is separately defined as earned shared savings/performance payment.
Economic additivity only. This does not establish geographic incidence or ledger inclusion.
ACO organizational connection is not payment-dollar incidence.
No county allocation is certified by this validator.
Performance year is not assumed to equal cash-payment FFY.
Negative EarnSaveLoss is not automatically treated as negative federal expenditure.
Withheld pending independent geographic-incidence and timing reconciliation.
